p: A bit of forward planning turns a good day here into a cracking one. The early birds tend to get the best of it, with shorter waits for the most popular machines before the crowds roll in. If you're visiting in the school holidays, arriving as the gates open is the smart move, and it leaves the afternoon free for something else nearby.

Clothes-wise, assume everything will get a little bit grubby. A spare outfit for the kids, a plastic bag for muddy trainers and a few wet wipes in your pocket make the trip home a lot more pleasant. Snacks and a drink in the bag keep energy up between rides too.

The location is a real bonus for stretching the day out. Whitwood sits right next to the Glasshoughton side of Castleford, so Xscape Yorkshire and the Junction 32 outlet shopping village are only minutes away if you fancy a change of scene once the kids are digger-ed out. Pontefract, famous for its liquorice and its ruined castle, is just down the road, and RSPB Fairburn Ings is a peaceful spot for a wildlife wander. Wakefield's Hepworth gallery and the Yorkshire Sculpture Park are within an easy drive too, if the grown-ups have earned a bit of culture after all that mud.
